text:
I'm sorry, that's stressful. Please do two things right now:

1. **Reset your Leafy password immediately** (and change it anywhere else you've used it).
2. **Contact your card issuer** to report the unauthorized charge, since it was made with your saved card.

This is suspected fraud on your account, so I'm escalating it to a Support Lead now. To help them, please send the order number (LF- plus six digits) from the unauthorized order. Don't send your full card number, security code, or password. If you'd rather email, help@leafy.example is answered within 1 business day.

Policy doesn't let me promise a cancellation or refund outcome here. Orders can be cancelled free only within 2 hours of ordering, and shipped orders can't be cancelled, so the Support Lead will review what can be done for this order.
